response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile staff-level engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but he lacks the core AI/GenAI specialization this role demands. His only AI-related exposure is a few months (since April 2025) touching MCP code generators and agentic tooling infrastructure — nowhere near the required 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions. There is no evidence of Python usage, RAG architectures, vector databases, cloud-native AI system design, or client-facing technical discovery leadership for AI initiatives, all of which are hard requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive staff/senior-level engineering experience (15+ years) across diverse tech stacks and domains
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, open source leadership)
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling, showing some directional alignment
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience and only minimal, very recent AI/GenAI work (a few months) versus the required 8+ years
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
No track record of designing AI systems on cloud platforms or leading AI-focused technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/GenAI domain experience (RAG, vector DBs, LLM systems)
No Python experience despite it being a core required language
Strong general staff-level engineering and mentoring background
